newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela military prison protest ends peacefully.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela military prison protest ends peacefully.

text.p: About 60 prisoners at a Venezuelan military jail ended a rooftop protest on Tuesday after human rights workers and a district attorney agreed to put their complaints to military authorities.

Inmates at the prison in Ramo Verde, 20 miles (30 km) west of Caracas, burned mattresses and occupied the roof of the four-storey building for more than 10 hours to draw attention to prison conditions.
They threw messages wrapped around stones to journalists in which they complained of overcrowded cells, infrequent family visits and slow judicial procedures.
Prison officials denied local radio reports suggesting that the prisoners had taken two guards hostage.
